about_the_game:
Soundtracks Full Edition of Leonardo’s Island – Origins
Composed by William Dodson

This exclusive package features eight original tracks from the game:

🎵 2 Day Themes – bright and uplifting, perfect for daytime exploration.

🌙 2 Night Themes – calm and mysterious, setting the mood for nighttime moments.

⚔️ 2 Battle Themes – energetic and intense, bringing the thrill of combat.

🏗️ 2 Construction Themes – steady and rhythmic, enhancing the spirit of building and creation.

Each track runs for around 3 minutes, composed exclusively for Leonardo’s Island – Origins.
